THERMAL ONLY, deliberately: power-sector emissions come from burning fuel, so hydro, wind, solar and nuclear must not carry any share of them. FY2022 to match the sector's reference year rather than the newest data - the proxy allocates a specific year's fuel and the fleet moved substantially by 2024 (Sindh 47.9, Punjab 42.5, Balochistan 9.6), so using 2024 shares on 2022 fuel would import a change that had not happened yet.
